scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: At [09:38]-[09:47], although the customer expressed satisfaction with the next-day DPD courier swap-out and temporary 4G fallback, the core 5G Hub overheating hardware fault depends on tomorrow's physical courier delivery (`SWP-884120`) and is not resolved during the call.

grader.scenario: 5G home broadband hub overheating with red thermal warning light and shutting down every two hours
grader.notes: Near-miss RE FAIL: Agent Daniel performs exemplary diagnostics (identifying a seized fan bearing at 0 RPM and 89C via telemetry), sets a temporary 4G low-thermal workaround, adds backup hotspot data, and books a next-day DPD courier replacement ([04:49], [08:27]). Even though Hiroshi says 'that sorts everything out for me!' at [09:47], RE is FAIL per Section 7.2 because fixing the seized 5G Hub hardware depends on tomorrow's courier delivery.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent opens with 'thank you for calling S-Net' and [10:06] closes with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: No hold or dead air gaps exceeding 30 seconds occurred during the call.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:11] Agent asks Hiroshi for the first line of his home address and four-digit security PIN, and [01:28] verifies his security question well within the first four minutes.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:15] Agent addresses the customer by name ('Hiroshi') throughout the conversation.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Agent says 'I'm really sorry to hear your 5G Hub is overheating and dropping your connection like that' and [00:35] validates the disruption to his work.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:51] Agent paraphrases: 'So to make sure I have captured the whole picture, your S-Net 5G Hub is running excessively hot, showing a solid red thermal light, and powering off roughly every two hours.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [05:07] Agent recalls Flat 4, 18 Crescent Mansions and [05:26] remembers that Hiroshi already confirmed the power brick was cool.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:40] Agent takes full ownership, [03:43]-[03:56] runs remote thermal telemetry, [04:49]-[06:21] books a next-day DPD swap-out with pre-paired eSIM and cloud config backup, and [06:59]-[08:00] sets a 4G low-thermal workaround, mobile hotspot pass, and £10 credit.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [04:11]-[08:00] Agent maintains a warm, proactive, and reassuring tone throughout the troubleshooting and dispatch setup.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:12]-[03:12] Agent probes systematically into hub placement, sunlight/radiators, vent dust, power brick temperature, and mechanical fan noises.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [04:29]-[04:49] Agent books a next-day DPD replacement hub (`1550-4928-3310`) for the seized internal cooling fan and [09:47] Hiroshi says 'That's brilliant, Daniel, thank you so much, that sorts everything out for me!', but the fix depends on a future hardware delivery.
